question: 单价最高的商品卖了多少件
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id join orders o on oi.order_id = o.order_id where o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY p.price DESC LIMIT 1
raw_output:
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) 
FROM order_items oi 
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id 
WHERE p.price = (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products)
